hooks.name: Auto-open Changed Files
hooks.description: Automatically opens any file in the editor after Kiro creates, edits, or moves it, so changes are always visible in the left editor pane

action.command: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $d.tool_input.path; if (-not $p) { $p = $d.tool_input.destinationPath }; if ($p) { if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($p)) { $p = Join-Path $d.cwd $p }; if (Test-Path $p) { & kiro --reuse-window $p *> $null } } } catch {}
